name: NEAR Transaction Health Checker
description: Analyzes a NEAR Protocol transaction hash and explains, in plain language, whether it succeeded or failed, why, and what to check next.
author: IronClaw Community Skills

tx_hash.description: The NEAR transaction hash to look up (base58, e.g. '2Bh8uAqFLwfUic7hmFXXYsThLsCckLHU8UQq6c2thi5u').

sender_account_id.description: Optional. The account ID that signed the transaction (e.g. 'alice.near'). If omitted, the skill auto-resolves it via a public explorer API.

network.description: Which NEAR network the transaction is on.

ok.description: Whether the transaction was found and analyzed.

success.description: Whether the transaction itself succeeded on-chain.

examples.description: Check a specific mainnet transaction with a known sender.
Check a transaction without knowing the sender; the skill resolves it automatically.
